title.purpose: Project names and panel headings at 0.875rem.

motion.name: panel-width
motion.purpose: Desktop sidebar and files panel. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled Workbench Blue action. Rare; one per cluster.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; padding: 5px 14px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 400 0.8125rem/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: 28px chrome control in the sidebar and top bar.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost" type="button" aria-label="New session"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { width: 28px; height: 28px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; color: var(--text-muted); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--bg-hover); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg-panel); color: var(--text); font: 400 0.8125rem/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Session Row
components.description: Signature 34px list row. Button unless renaming.
components.css: .ds-session-row { height: 34px; width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); font: 400 0.8125rem/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-session-row:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); color: var(--text); } .ds-session-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-session-row[data-selected="true"] { background: var(--bg-selected); color: var(--text); } .ds-session-row-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--border); flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-session-row-title { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Sidebar
components.html: pi-web
components.css: .ds-sidebar { width: 260px; padding: 8px; background: var(--bg-panel); color: var(--text); border-right: 1px solid var(--border); font: 400 0.8125rem/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-sidebar-project { height: 36px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 8px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-session-row { height: 34px; width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-session-row[data-selected="true"] { background: var(--bg-selected); color: var(--text); } .ds-session-row-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-session-row-title { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Floating workbench layer. Shadow only here.
components.html:
Rename session

Management metadata only. Session files stay put.
components.css: .ds-dialog { width: min(420px, 100%); padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(15, 23, 42, .18); font: 400 0.8125rem/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-dialog strong { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.25; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-dialog p { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; padding: 5px 14px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Pi Web is a quiet instrument: a dense local coding desk where the sidebar is the tool rack, the conversation is the bench, and files sit in a drawer. It is familiar to Codex desktop users on purpose. Personality lives in restraint, not decoration.

Surfaces are paper and charcoal. One Workbench Blue marks selection, focus, and the rare filled action. Type stays at UI scale. There is no marketing display face and no card grid of projects.
keyCharacteristics: Codex-density sidebar of rows, not cards
Neutral canvas; one accent used sparingly
Flat surfaces at rest; shadow only on floating layers
System UI sans + monospace for data
Light and dark remap the same roles (`:root` / `html.dark`)

rules.name: The Workbench Blue Rule
rules.body: Accent occupies a small fraction of any screen. If a layout needs color to look finished, the layout is wrong.

rules.name: The Token Role Rule
rules.body: Use --accent, --error, --warning, --ok. Do not introduce a second red or green.

rules.name: The UI-Scale Rule
rules.body: Do not add a display or headline size. The largest chrome type is 0.875rem.

rules.name: The Row-Not-Card Rule
rules.body: Projects and sessions are list rows. Do not wrap them in equal-height cards.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadows appear only on floating layers (dialog, menu, switcher). Never to make a list look like a dashboard.

rules.name: The Quiet Corner Rule
rules.body: Rows stay at 5px. Do not pill an entire session row.

dos: Do keep projects visible as sidebar rows at 28–36px.
Do use --accent for selection, focus, and one primary action.
Do keep resting surfaces flat with 1px --border.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion (no sidebar/panel width animation).
Do map light/dark through the same token roles.
donts: Don't restore the project-selector dropdown as primary navigation.
Don't use card grids, hero metrics, or decorative dashboards for projects.
Don't add display type, gradient text, or glass panels.
Don't put a drop shadow under a list row to “lift” it.
